title: Bundler module documents network APIs in comments and emits runtime code as strings
intent: Observed in undici, ky, mongodb, webpack, less, playwright-core and nx releases: JSDoc examples (`import { createServer } from 'node:http'`), prose comments naming fetch(), eval-shaped runtime templates emitted as string literals (`"WebAssembly.compile(bytes)"`, `"eval()"`; network calls inside strings still count, because code in a string can run through vm sinks that are not findings), a method named eval, the CommonJS dynamic-import shim and es6-promise's global shim. None is a network call or eval, so neither code.network-access nor code.dynamic-evaluation should fire.
